root_hooks.action: Import steamLambDefinitions from steam_lamb_content.js; append steam_lamb to STEAM_ABSORPTION_GROUPS and steamLambDefinitions to the aggregated definition families. No items/sites/actors are declared by this slice.
Import steamLambFacts and validateSteamLambState from steam_lamb_facts.js; include the facts and run its optional validator.
Import steamLambContext, commitSteamLambCommand and steamLambPresentation from steam_lamb_host.js; add steam_lamb to the existing hosts map.

Import guardSteamLambAdmission, stampSteamLambAcceptedJob and steamLambCompletionContext from steam_lamb_runtime.js. Call guard at admission beside the existing DF/BOH/ONI guards; stamp after costs and completionSupport/participants are frozen, before enqueue; wrap current completion context with steamLambCompletionContext before simulationFacts/meets. The wrapper must see the existing bench reservation even though the completing job has been removed from the jobs list.

required_context: Same native body/alive/care-frame/inventory/vitals/equipment/external context as BOH. Timed commands target feature_objects.miri; ending is immediate player-only target=null and has no current-source requirement.
save_compatibility: Optional actor facts/completed/knowledge/common jobs only, expansion11/simulation5 unchanged; office belongs existing Eda; approval refers fungible Matched repair stave class, no copy identity/provenance.
